scope.experiment: Exploratory frontend partition/density grid; network and retrieval are rerun for each configuration, with legacy backend policy.
scope.disclosure: All three TUM sequences and their earlier results were inspected before these adaptations were designed. These are exploratory external-sequence validations, not unseen test data.
scope.selection_metric: Minimum finite own-trajectory Sim(3) ATE RMSE on desk only, as originally fixed. Validation and supplementary common-time results do not reselect parameters.
scope.grid: 16/32 new frames per submap × minimum disparity 25/50/75 pixels; one previous frame overlaps each noninitial submap.
scope.default_change_rule: A default change needs at least 2% lower ATE on each of desk2 and room vs freshly reproduced matching legacy; otherwise expose opt-in and preserve legacy default.
scope.hardware_note: hardware_infeasible describes failure under the configured GPU process memory budget and reserve. It is not an accuracy measurement or a claim that the physical GPU can never run this configuration.

metric_definitions.own_trajectory_ate: Reference-driven nearest-time association within 0.01 s and independent Sim(3) alignment; each run has its own selected timestamps, so this does not control evaluation support across disparities.
metric_definitions.common_interpolated_trajectory_ate: Both predicted trajectories are linearly interpolated, without extrapolation, at identical GT timestamps in their pairwise common interval, then independently Sim(3)-aligned. This measures the interpolated trajectory representation on that support, combining sampling and prediction errors.
metric_definitions.interpretation_limit: Common-time interpolation does not recover true motion between keyframes and cannot isolate keyframe geometric error. Its ratio must not be described as a geometric-error ratio or subtracted from own-trajectory ATE to infer an interpolation-only component.
metric_definitions.pairwise_support: Common intervals and alignment supports can differ across candidate comparisons; each common baseline score belongs to its own matched pair.
metric_definitions.exact_shared_prediction_subset: Only exactly shared prediction timestamps are used, retaining predicted positions and interpolating GT. Counts below 20 are flagged small; separate Sim(3) fits and limited coverage can make small subsets unstable.
metric_definitions.role: Common-time and shared-prediction metrics are supplementary robustness checks. They do not alter the original desk selection criterion or create a new numerical success threshold.

original_adaptation_plan.purpose: Exploratory system adaptation; previously viewed TUM data are not an unseen benchmark
original_adaptation_plan.selection: Freeze one backend candidate using desk ATE only; report desk2 and room separately and pooled geometric mean ratio, no retuning on validation. Change one mechanism at a time before combined candidate.
original_adaptation_plan.frontend_selection: Compare on desk; pick at most one new density/size configuration for both validation sequences. Fixed same-frame context probe is a diagnostic, not a score-selection pool.
original_adaptation_plan.success_rule: A default change needs at least 2% lower ATE on each of desk2 and room vs freshly reproduced matching legacy; otherwise expose opt-in and preserve legacy default.
original_adaptation_plan.gpu: one cooperating GPU job at a time, shared existing lock, >=2048 MiB reserve, foreign compute PID check before forwards
original_adaptation_plan.replay: Cache complete predictions including accepted loops. Verify legacy CPU replay against online poses before selecting backend candidates. Replay measures backend effects conditional on fixed front-end/retrieval outputs.

amendments.stage: before backend candidate selection and validation
amendments.change: Specify minimum practical improvement of 2% on each validation sequence, stricter than any numeric decrease.

design.selection_rule: Minimum finite Sim(3) ATE on this named development sequence only; exact ties prefer baseline, then fixed grid order. Only completed feasible runs are scored. Validation never selects.
design.resume_rule: Completed outputs require matching inference/evaluation args and full prediction-cache frame lists. Failed/incomplete directories are preserved and never rerun in place.
limitations: Development-sequence optimization is not evidence of generalization.
OOM/resource failures are hardware infeasibility, never accuracy scores.
Expected checkpoint SHA is recorded; only run_slam --verify-checkpoints records an independently measured full checkpoint SHA.
Disparity changes keyframe timestamps. The prespecified own-trajectory ATE selection does not control evaluation time support; common-time evaluation must be reported separately.
Caller is responsible for any systemd MemoryMax scope; each child acquires the shared GPU lock.

frozen_selection.selection_rule: Minimum finite Sim(3) ATE on this named development sequence only; exact ties prefer baseline, then fixed grid order. Only completed feasible runs are scored. Validation never selects.
frozen_selection.disclosure: Parameters selected on the named development sequence only. Resource failures are unscored. Held-out sequences must use --frozen-selection and never reselect. Own-trajectory ATE uses configuration-specific keyframe timestamps.

summary.decision: Keep the legacy frontend default. Both original frozen-candidate validation runs were hardware-limited and are unscored.

provenance.hash_convention: Hashes identify original file bytes before path redaction. Embedded source objects retain original fields and numeric values; metadata excerpts explicitly name omitted fields.
provenance.path_redaction: Absolute project paths made relative, external dataset root replaced by <TUM_ROOT>, and local interpreter executable replaced by python3. Numerical values and frozen hashes are unchanged.
provenance.artifact_note: Relative runs paths are provenance labels for ignored experiment artifacts, not a claim that their large contents are included.

amendment.purpose: Memory-only execution retry after the frozen frontend validation exceeded the existing allocator cap
amendment.change: Move completed submap image tensors to CPU and copy retrieved loop images back, preserving dtype and values
amendment.gate: Require exact trajectory bytes, update frames/counts and every cached model prediction array before either validation retry

adoption_criterion.definition: A default change needs at least 2% lower ATE on each of desk2 and room vs freshly reproduced matching legacy; otherwise expose opt-in and preserve legacy default.

memory_only_retry.note: The execution-only CPU storage change is queued behind the existing shared GPU lock. No equivalence pass or retry accuracy result is claimed. Original hardware-limited validation remains in original_validation.
